d.ko: South Park 제작자인 트레이 파커와 맷 스톤이 South Park: The Fractured but Whole을 선보입니다. 2014년 수상 경력에 빛나는 South Park: The Stick of Truth의 속편이죠.
d.en: From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes South Park: The Fractured But Whole, a sequel to 2014's award-winning South Park: The Stick of Truth.
d.zh: From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes South Park: The Fractured But Whole, a sequel to 2014's award-winning South Park: The Stick of Truth.

짜증나는 유플레이 연동시켜야해서 비추밖지만... 잠깐 해봤는데 진리의 막대기보다 체감상 2.5배는 발전되고 컨텐츠가 더 많은 게임이라는게 느껴짐. 추가로 고프레임시(EX 180fps) 글리치가 있는데 게임내에서는 주사율을 따로 잡아줄수 없고 그래픽 설정으로 직접 잡아줘야됨.. …

This game is filled with fan-service, though the game does not offer the exact same depth we know from the series. Thankfully the videogame itself is a lot of fun and will keep you laughing for many hours.
